ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Research Experience in Number Theory. See http://www.math.uiuc.edu/timetable/ for the full course description. Undergraduate students may register with approval. For more information go to room 313 AH. Students from the following programs must contact the Director of Graduate Studies in Mathematics <Laugesen@illinois.edu> to request permission to register for the course: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
